name: pi-scope
description: Local-first observability dashboard for AI coding agents: watch and replay every message, tool call, shell command, and file edit live in a private, self-hosted browser UI.
//: Pi Scope keeps no node_modules in the checkout: apps/scope-desktop/app-deps-install.mjs installs these (plus the bundled pi agent and the server's runtime packages) into ~/.pi-scope/pi and everything resolves from there. The runtime packages are declared in apps/scope-desktop/pi-bundle/package.json, not here — that manifest is what ships inside the packaged app's read-only seed.
//allowScripts: Build-step approvals merged into ~/.pi-scope/pi's manifest (see npm's install-scripts audit): Electron downloads its binary, esbuild/ffmpeg-static fetch their platform binaries.
